$comment: Observed disagreements between the pinned report schema (#447) and the
Action's parseReport verdicts, one entry per disagreement, written from
(not predictions). direction names which side accepts the report:
'schema-rejects/action-accepts' means the schema rejects the report but
parseReport accepts it; 'schema-accepts/action-rejects' is the reverse.
The differential test requires this list to match the observed set of
disagreements exactly, so a stale or missing entry fails the test.

divergences.reason: The schema marks counts as required, but parseReport re-derives counts from results/skipped instead of rejecting the report (CF-01 section 3 requires counts; the Action tolerates engines that predate it rather than discarding an otherwise complete compatibility report).
divergences.description: Permits backward compatibility with older engine reports omitting explicit counts by re-deriving summary totals from results and skipped arrays.

divergences.reason: A counts object missing any member fails the schema's required list, but the Action's shape check tolerates a missing 'skipped' member and re-derives all counts from results/skipped anyway.
divergences.description: Tolerates missing member within counts object and recalculates summary metrics from results rather than discarding the report.

divergences.reason: A non-object counts value fails the schema's type keyword; the Action treats any counts value it cannot read as 'not recorded' and re-derives counts instead of rejecting.
divergences.description: Treats non-object counts defensively as unrecorded metadata and recovers accurate counts through results array derivation.

divergences.reason: A non-numeric counts member fails the schema's integer type; the Action's counts shape check fails closed into derivation (counts re-derived from results/skipped) rather than rejecting the report.
divergences.description: Recovers from non-numeric count members by re-deriving valid integer counts from results and skipped lists.

divergences.reason: JSON Schema 'type: object' does not admit null, but the Action deliberately treats an explicit network: null the same as an absent network field — an offline run, never an error.
divergences.description: Treats an explicit null network value identically to an absent network field, denoting an offline execution rather than an error.

divergences.reason: The schema constrains project.type to a controlled vocabulary, but the Action only requires it to be a non-empty string: CF-01 says consumers must treat unknown project types as opaque text, not as a reason to discard the report.
divergences.description: Accepts unlisted project type strings as opaque identifiers per CF-01 specification to avoid discarding future engine reports.

divergences.reason: The schema requires results[].protocol to be an integer, but the Action's result shape check only requires a number — the value is informational (equals targetProtocol) and is never rendered or compared as an integer by the Action.
divergences.description: Accepts numeric protocol values without strict integer coercion because protocol is informational metadata.

divergences.reason: The schema floors results[].protocol at 1; the Action only checks it is a number and does not enforce the minimum, for the same reason as the non-integer case.
divergences.description: Permits protocol values below 1 without failing report parsing since protocol values are informational context.

divergences.reason: The schema requires results[].durationMs to be an integer; the Action only requires a number. CF-01 marks durationMs as unstable data that must never be compared, so a fractional value cannot change a compatibility verdict.
divergences.description: Allows floating-point execution durations because durationMs is unstable timing metadata never used for compatibility verdicts.

divergences.reason: The schema floors results[].durationMs at 0; the Action does not enforce the minimum — a negative duration is bad engine data but not a reason to discard an otherwise valid report.
divergences.description: Tolerates negative duration values defensively to preserve valid test execution records and findings.

divergences.reason: The schema types results[].source as a string, but the Action's result shape check does not validate source at all — the field is read defensively and unknown values are treated as 'not live', so a wrong-typed value cannot fake compatibility evidence.
divergences.description: Permits non-string source properties by treating unknown or invalid source values defensively as non-live tests.

divergences.reason: The schema types git as an object; the Action does not validate git at all — it is provenance context rendered defensively, so a malformed value is never a reason to discard a compatibility result.
divergences.description: Treats git provenance metadata defensively so malformed repository context does not invalidate compatibility test findings.

divergences.reason: The schema types verbose as a boolean; the Action does not validate the field — it is informational metadata the Action never reads.
divergences.description: Ignores type mismatches in verbose flag because verbose output settings are informational metadata never read by the Action.

divergences.reason: The schema requires run.toolBuildCommit when run is present; the Action does not validate the run object — engine build provenance is copied through to the Execution Receipt defensively, never used for a verdict.
divergences.description: Passes through run execution metadata defensively without enforcing toolBuildCommit presence for verdict generation.

divergences.reason: The schema constrains skipped[].surface to the three-surface enum, but the Action's skip shape check accepts any non-empty string: skipped entries are planner output, and CF-01 treats their surface as free-form provenance text rather than a controlled vocabulary.
divergences.description: Permits arbitrary non-empty string surfaces for skipped entries treating surface as free-form planner provenance.

divergences.reason: The schema makes results[].fixtureId optional, but the Action requires every result to carry fixtureId as a string or explicit null (results are keyed by (surface, fixtureId) for the duplicate-identity check, so an absent fixtureId would silently change a result's identity).
divergences.description: Enforces fixtureId presence (as string or null) to guarantee deterministic duplicate identity checks on (surface, fixtureId) pairs.

divergences.reason: The schema cannot express cross-field consistency; the Action rejects a report whose counts disagree with what results/skipped actually contain, because doctored or truncated counts could mask a failure.
divergences.description: Rejects reports where recorded counts conflict with actual results array length to prevent doctored summaries masking failures.

divergences.reason: The schema has no uniqueness constraint over results; the Action rejects a report where two results share a (surface, identity) pair, per CF-01 section 4 — a duplicated passing result could otherwise mask a failure.
divergences.description: Rejects reports containing duplicate (surface, fixtureId) result pairs per CF-01 section 4 to prevent masking test failures.

divergences.reason: The schema admits an empty toolVersion string; the Action requires it to be non-empty — an empty version is a broken engine build marker, and the field is displayed in annotations and receipts.
divergences.description: Requires non-empty toolVersion string because blank versions represent corrupt engine builds and are shown in GitHub annotations.

divergences.reason: The schema admits an empty project.name; the Action requires it non-empty — the name is rendered in the job summary and annotation text, where an empty value would silently produce misleading output.
divergences.description: Requires non-empty project.name string to ensure meaningful job summary rendering and avoid misleading blank titles.

divergences.reason: The schema admits an empty network.name string; the Action requires it non-empty — an empty network name would render as a blank identity in annotations while implying a live run was performed.
divergences.description: Requires non-empty network.name string so live execution identity is never ambiguously rendered as blank in CI annotations.
